scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run dev --workspace client" "npm run dev --workspace server"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace client && npm run build --workspace server
scripts.setup:env: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); const files=['.env.example','client/.env.example','server/.env.example']; files.forEach(f=>{ if(!fs.existsSync(f)) console.log('missing', f); });"
